meta.label: TabPFN v2 in context on simulated rows (a lens, not a release; Built with PriorLabs-TabPFN)
meta.family_label: Tabular foundation model (TabPFN v2, in-context, zero real labels)
meta.numpy_only_reason: TabPFN is a transformer run with torch (tabpfn 10.2.0, copied in pylib/); it has no numpy port. A yardstick, not a release candidate.

compute.notes: no training (in-context learning: no gradient step); building a context takes ~3 s; the context forward pass (fit_mode fit_with_cache) runs at load in every process (r1: ~22 s CPU); prediction ~10.6 ms CPU per row at r1 (sim val 66 s, dev gate 128 s; the exam's ~121k rows ~21 min); setup probes of speed / memory (8 runs, ~0.13 CPU-h) are not training

meta.feature_engineering: a scoped input set: the 38 top-ranked of the 151 inputs by the GBM r0 mean model's gain on the simulated train bank (one-hot architecture / class columns skipped there) + architecture and class as two categorical codes (argmax of the one-hot blocks); target z = log(y / E_phys); context = 2,048 random simulated train trips under one tier draw (default_rng(5))
